services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: In-person field trips at the Adler Planetarium are fun, out-of-this-world learning experiences for PreK-12 school groups. You can book field trips every day of the year, all year long! Your group will enjoy hands-on, minds-on activities and explore mind-blowing facts about the universe that will stay with them long after they’ve left the museum. On most Tuesdays and Thursdays throughout the school year, the museum will be open exclusively to PreK-12 school groups from 9:00 am - 11:00 am. After 11:00 am, the general public will be welcomed alongside our school groups on Tuesdays and Thursdays. School groups are welcome to visit any day of the week during open museum hours. services.desc: Host your event at the iconic Adler Planetarium for a truly memorable Chicago experience. Reserve a front row seat to the universe in one of the museum’s two domed theaters, enjoy a selection of self-directed and staff-facilitated activities, explore 60,000 square feet of exhibitions, and see the sky as you never have before through the Doane Observatory’s research-quality telescope. The Adler features unique and beautiful spaces, great food, and a view of Chicago’s skyline that will take your breath away. services.name: Museum Programs
services.desc: As Chicago’s planetarium for the past century, the Adler has always cherished its role as a member of our community. Neighbors all across the city can look through telescopes with us in their own public libraries and parks or nerd out with our astrophysicists and historians at C2E2. Adler staff have painted moonshot murals (that you can still see on display at the museum!) with a diverse range of artists and residents, regularly appeared on local radio and TV to break down the latest in space, helped local teens educate their neighbors about light pollution, and hosted massive viewing parties for recent solar eclipses.
